<observations>
Date: Jun 18 - Jun 27, 2026
* 🔴 Wedding preferences & details: Outdoor hilltop ceremony (moved to garden pavilion, start time 14:00), vintage décor, buffet dinner, live string quartet with custom arrangement, "Midnight Sunset" signature cocktail, pet-friendly zone, 150 guests.
* 🟡 Key vendors & logistics: Mountain Meadow Catering (vegan dessert), GreenBite Bakery (vegan cheese platter $120), AV setup ($450, backup mic, projector on western balcony), transportation schedule finalized, florist confirmed as Marisol Etxeberria.
* ✅ (Jun 27) Initial vendor contracts, seating charts, and budget reports completed and shared with user.

Date: Jul 1, 2026
* 🟡 Logistics updates: 12 mobility-accessible tables, navy blue table labels, 20-foot floral centerpiece contract amendment, backup bridal bouquet options sourced.
* 🟡 Budget update: AeroShots drone video added ($350, total budget $12,400).
* ✅ (13:30) Timeline PDF shared and complete status update emailed to user.

Date: Jul 5, 2026
* 🔴 User stated the rehearsal dinner will be at a winery in Paso Robles.
* 🟡 Vendors & Additions: Muted gold signage, Harmony Strings acoustic band for cocktail hour ($1,200, entertainment total $13,600), venue outdoor terrace contract amendment, backup photographer options sourced, cake topper reminder set.
* ✅ (13:30) Timeline PDF shared, revised budget and vendor timeline emailed to user.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Acknowledge and integrate the rehearsal dinner location (winery in Paso Robles) into the planning documents.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've noted that the rehearsal dinner will be at a winery in Paso Robles. Would you like me to coordinate with any specific caterers or transportation for that venue?"
</suggested-response>
